profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Expertise in Microservices, System Design, Event-driven architecture, Agentic AI
profile.summary:
I'm a Staff Software Engineer with 12+ years in health tech — the kind of work where shipping well actually changes patient outcomes.

At Blooming Health, I architected the company's core platform: a distributed, event-driven system powering AI-driven tools that help healthcare workers manage growing caseloads. Earlier, at Koneksa, I enabled remote clinical-trial data collection — streamlining study configuration and building the auditable change history that regulatory compliance demands.

I work at the intersection of solid engineering and agentic AI. My conviction is that pairing a strong technical foundation with AI-assisted development dramatically shortens the path from idea to impact — and that shapes how I build, mentor, and lead.

I'm an AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, currently working toward the Professional certification.

Always glad to connect with others building thoughtful technology in healthcare and beyond.

If you made it this far, should I do something about all these em dashes?

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Architect and deliver a 0-to-1, event-driven platform on GCP — 11 Go microservices that feed and consume data from AI agents screening 1,000+ vulnerable patients to improve health outcomes
- Build serverless GCP services that broker communication between AI agents and the core platform, scaling to 13,000 requests/day at 99.9% uptime while reducing operational overhead
- Drive agentic AI adoption across an engineering org of 24 engineers — ran training, defined best practices, identified high-value use cases, and integrated Claude, Gemini, and Copilot into the team's Linear and GitHub workflows
- Cut feature delivery from weeks to days (62% faster) by orchestrating AI agent teams across planning, design, implementation, testing, and review
- Embed AI into daily engineering, delegating bug fixes, vulnerability patches, and code review to CLI- and GitHub-based agents to free the team for higher-value work
- Lead a team of 24 engineers — setting technical direction, reviewing code, and mentoring toward higher autonomy and delivery quality
- Own architectural and key technical decisions for platform/domain, balancing delivery speed against reliability, observability, and long-term maintainability
- Partner cross-functionally with product / clinical / data stakeholders to translate requirements into a technical roadmap and shippable milestones
- Drive engineering hiring — interviewing, defining the technical bar, and onboarding new engineers
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · AI Software Development · Claude Skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
- Plan, estimate and build the next generation of a multi-tenant clinical trial platform to allow easier study configuration, remote data collection, faster feature delivery and better resource optimization 
- Design and build an audit trail service that asynchronously consumes change capture data using Apache Kafka within a microservice architecture to enhance data tracking and integrity across the system
- Design and build a reporting service to serve exportable, human-readable reports of audit trail data allowing clinical study coordinators and sponsors to reduce time/effort to validate clinical study protocols
- Design and build a localization service to manage and serve translations of assessments and help documents to participants and translation providers reducing study translation time by 13 days
- Design and build a service to configure and serve text-based and device assessments to participants in clinical trials
- Build and maintain a GraphQL service to provide a uniform, flexible interface for a React client to request data from Golang microservices exposing RESTful APIs documented with OpenAPI
- Redesign an existing iterative scheduling service to leverage an event-driven architecture to improve system performance and scalability by reducing load on downstream services
- Implement versioning in the core platform to allow clients to change study configurations without affecting scheduling and compliance as participants are onboarded during a clinical trial
- Leverage AI via Amazon Q, Goose for debugging, feature development, test coverage
- Maintain and monitor applications with New Relic to debug, optimize execution, ensure scalability
- Build CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions and containerized applications to automate testing, compile build artifacts, verify pull request requirements and deploy builds to multiple environments
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Technology Leadership · Leading Development Teams · Go (Programming Language) · MongoDB · Apache Kafka · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GraphQL · Docker · Redis · Kubernetes · Open API · TypeScript · Swagger

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Build robust, fault tolerant external integrations with third-party DMV registration APIs to automate car titling and registration resulting in a 62% MoM increase in registrations
- Design and build a service to determine and request required documents from customers to finalize car purchases based on financing information raising conversion rate by 25%
- Design and build a service to manage and share customer documents uploaded during car purchase workflow increasing service rep productivity by providing quick access to required documentation
- Oversee the technical work for a cross-functional team of engineers, SQA and Devops
- Provide mentorship and support to team members to help advance their careers
- Work with Product team to define technical roadmap, plan upcoming features, help provide estimates and breakdown features for team work/execution
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Software Infrastructure · Technology Leadership · Technical Staff Management · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Team Lead
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Lead multiple cross-functional Agile teams of engineers and SETs, enhancing team collaboration and
product delivery
- Define team goals, mentor team members, handle performance reviews and career roadmaps
- Lead multiple high-visibility projects, provide SWAG and refined estimates, lead technical direction for a cross-functional team ensuring successful project completion and alignment with company goals
- Collaborate with team leads and staff engineers to develop department-wide best practices
- Collaborate with Product to define technical roadmap, prioritize features and break down technical requirements
- Explain technical details to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge 
- Integrate Apache Kafka as the message bus of an event-driven microservice architecture to improve performance and scalability
- Maintain and monitor application performance using New Relic, Datadog and LogDNA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain a monolith Ruby on Rails application backed by Neo4j database to handle core platform functionality
- Build client screening functionality in core application to identify client needs based on assessment responses
- Collaborate with various teams to design an event-driven architecture to replace a monolith application using Domain Driven Design tools and principles thereby improving performance and scalability of the core platform
- Build and maintain a Go microservice with Protobuf api layer to manage client assessments 
- Build and maintain a Go microservice with Protobuf api layer to manage client/demographic data
- Migrate system data from version 2 of the core application platform backed by Postgres to version 3 backed by Neo4j graph database
- Manage CI/CD for applications via Kubernetes
- Build and maintain software architectures using Amazon Web Services
- Build and maintain features in the Core Platform: Ruby on Rails API
- Build component-based SPAs using React and Redux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build content management system to draft and publish articles written by internal editorial team using Ruby on Rails and MongoDB
- Improve web page loading and application performance using Redis for caching
- Create multiple interactive UIs using ReactJS, BackboneJS
- Lead engineering department guild to establish best practices across teams
- Conduct A/B tests with Optimizely to inform design and product development
- Write unit and integration tests in RSpec and Cucumber
- Manage applications with regular production deployment cycles on Heroku and AWS
- Monitor applications with New Relic and Honeybadger
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · Backbone.js · PostgreSQL · Heroku · Optimizely · Mixpanel · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Redis · Memcached

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Build and maintain front-end for HuffPost Live web application: a web-based streaming news service
- Build and maintain a content management system using Ruby on Rails to allow producers to develop shows, schedule guests and organize assets related to televised news production
- Increase page load speed on main site by profiling and optimizing JavaScript, leveraging browser caching, reducing build artifact size and optimizing compression
- Add activity monitoring using Mixpanel to better understand usage patterns and inform new features
- Add high-coverage unit tests for Backbone-based modules with Jasmine
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Ruby on Rails · Backbone.js · PostgreSQL · Cucumber · Jasmine Framework

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Lead research, vetting and early adoption of client-side frameworks, libraries, plugins
- Build front-end MVVM frameworks with modular CoffeeScript, Require, Backbone
- Build and maintain multiple web applications built with Ruby on Rails
- Testing/BDD using Jasmine for unit tests and Cucumber for integration tests
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · Backbone.js · CoffeeScript · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Build responsive web UIs with CSS, jQuery and vanilla Javascript
- Build server-side applications using Ruby on Rails
- Build a cross-platform mobile recipe-sharing application called Foodily with PhoneGap
- Work with Product to define stories and provide estimates for delivery
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · jQuery · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PhoneGap · iOS development · Objective-C · JavaScript
